additional_info.subject: RE: AW: 0385268 - ID0385268-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R1 170001443] Black Screen showing English text only & unable to charge VW vehicles from the ID series (ID3, ID4) CRM:02023000223
additional_info.body:
Hello Rudolf,
Hope you are doing well.
I have reviewed the logs from October 21st, starting at 10 AM German Time. It appears that the VW vehicle encountered an error with the code V2G - message timeout, which prevented it from charging.
As per your request, we are forwarding this ticket to our expert team to initiate a downgrade of the charger firmware. Once the firmware has been downgraded, you will be able to attempt charging your VW vehicle again.
Thank you for your patience, and please let me know if you have any further questions.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
